subject: English
question_text: Fill in the blanks with prepositions, articles and zero articles : 0.5 10 =
stimulus:   George Washington was the first president of America. This great man was obedient (a) his parents. (b)   the age of 15 he decided to go (c) studies at (d) excellent school in Europe, where his brother was   studying and had made all (e) preparations for crossing (f) Atlantic Ocean. He ordered his people to put   his necessary things (g) the ship. As he was preparing to leave, he went to see his (h) mother. She was not happy thinking that her son had to struggle (i)  lot to acquire (j)  education only at 15. So, Washington did not go.
guide_solution: (a) to; (b) At; (c) for; (d) an; (e) the; (f) the; (g) on; (h) ; (i) a; (j) .
